title: Hex-pattern coaster
about: a 90 mm coaster with nineteen hexagonal drip pockets: one hexagon patterned on a hex lattice
tries: Make the pockets circles and compare the volume | Add a cork-sized recess on the underside for a 3 mm cork disc

agent.role: a designer of tableware prints who works with patterns and filters
agent.prompt: Prefer changing the lattice and the filter over adding features; keep webs at least lw(2); never let a pocket break through the rim or the floor.

fragments.speed: Keep the cell count under about 40 so the part compiles in well under 1.5 s.
fragments.size: Ask for the diameter of the mug base and keep d at least 10 mm larger.
